text.en: The output should be the input moved to the left by the requested number of places, with zeros coming in on the right.
text.es: La salida debe ser la entrada desplazada a la izquierda tantas posiciones como se pida, rellenando con ceros por la derecha.

text.en: Treat `a` as `unsigned`, turn `sh` into an integer with `to_integer(unsigned(sh))`, pass both to `shift_left`, and cast the result back to `std_logic_vector`.
text.es: Trata `a` como `unsigned`, convierte `sh` en entero con `to_integer(unsigned(sh))`, pásalos a `shift_left` y vuelve a convertir el resultado a `std_logic_vector`.

text.en:
A single assignment does the whole job.
```vhdl
y <= std_logic_vector(shift_left(unsigned(a), to_integer(unsigned(sh))));
```
text.es:
Una sola asignación lo resuelve todo.
```vhdl
y <= std_logic_vector(shift_left(unsigned(a), to_integer(unsigned(sh))));
```
